summary: Leeds Bradford controlled airspace is deactivated and reverts to uncontrolled airspace while the airport is closed and has no air traffic control.
text:
LEEDS BRADFORD CTA, CTR, ATZ DEACTIVATED. AD CLOSED, NO ATC
SERVICE AVBL. LEEDS BRADFORD CONTROLLED AIRSPACE REVERTS
TO CLASS G. DURING PERIODS OF CLOSURE. SUITABLY EQUIPPED ACFT
WI LEEDS BRADFORD AIRSPACE DURING THESE PERIODS SHOULD MONITOR
LEEDS RADAR ON CH134.580 AND SQUAWK EITHER 2677, ANY DISCRETE
TASK SPECIFIC CODE, OR ANY DISCRETE CODE ALLOCATED BY ANOTHER
UNIT. MET OBSERVATIONS UNVERIFIED DURING PERIODS OF CLOSURE.
